endpointBinding: The original public-landmark route is bound to the stable local catalog coordinates for deterministic lookup; it is not a device-location recording.
note: Five directed pedestrian legs were recorded through the local /journey/plan flow. A sixth leg is a disclosed concatenation of two recorded legs so the fatigue case can remove an optional visit without inventing a new direct route. This is a fixed regression fixture, not Apple MapKit, not TfNSW, and not live navigation.

legs.note: Concatenated from two recorded Valhalla/OSM legs; it still passes the Opera House but does not schedule a visit there.
